verdict.rationale: Dover's docs describe a single candidate profile where everything lives, covering resume, emails, interviews, feedback, notes and files; the interview page and calendar invite also link back to that profile. Nothing in the evidence shows a per-candidate activity-history timeline or any consent-status field on the record, so only three of the five named elements are documented. Missing for 10: activity history/audit timeline on the profile, consent status tracking, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record

citations.quote: A candidate's profile is where everything about them lives: their details, resume, application answers, emails, interviews, feedback, notes, and files.
Click **Add feedback** on the candidate's profile. The **View in Dover** link in the calendar invite opens the profile.
It shows the candidate's details, their resume, and the feedback form assigned to the interview stage.
